condition: A DataFrame/Series built from a NumPy structured array column (compound np.dtype) gets created without error, but later operations break: .loc setitem raises AssertionError, print/repr raises a TypeError from isnan, and multi-column selection fails.
workaround: Store the structured data as fixed-width bytes, e.g. arr.astype(f'S{dtype.itemsize}') or .view(...), or let the column use object dtype.
